verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical. Both squeeze the subhead 'Every mixed case.' into a cramped three-line wrap next to the Shop Sale button, and both shrink the legal line to illegible micro-text jammed under the CTA. In both, the shoe sits off-centre in the bottom-left of the peach circle, leaving the top of the circle empty. Everything is pushed into a crowded bottom strip. The only difference is that B's circle and shoe sit a few pixels lower, which changes nothing.
